stakeholders.name: Miners Association of Nigeria (MAN)
stakeholders.description: Represent miners across Nigeria and advocate for enabling policies, better operating conditions and sector development.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Sector advocacy, coordination and representation of ASM and small-scale miners.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Acts as an umbrella body for miner cooperatives; engages government on policies, taxation and access to finance; provides a platform for dialogue between miners, government and communities.

stakeholders.name: Nigeria Artisanal and Small-Scale Miners Association (NASSMA)
stakeholders.description: Organise and represent artisanal and small-scale miners across key mining states in Nigeria.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: ASM formalisation, representation and engagement with regulators and buyers.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Supports the formalisation of ASM; represents ASM interests before government; promotes safer, more productive mining practices and improved market access for small-scale miners.

stakeholders.name: Women in Mining in Nigeria (WIMIN)
stakeholders.description: Promote womenâ€™s participation, rights and leadership in Nigeriaâ€™s mining and minerals sector, especially in ASM communities.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Gender inclusion, advocacy and capacity building within ASM and mining.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Organises women miners and traders into networks and cooperatives; delivers training on safety, business skills and rights; advocates for gender-responsive mining governance and community benefits.
stakeholders.mineralFocus: All minerals with strong ASM focus

stakeholders.name: Association of Women Miners in Nigeria (AWMN)
stakeholders.description: Support women directly involved in artisanal and small-scale mining and mineral trading.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Organisation and empowerment of women miners along the ASM value chain.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Provides a platform for women miners to access training, finance and markets; works with government and partners to improve safety, income and recognition of women in ASM.
stakeholders.mineralFocus: Gold and gemstones, plus other ASM minerals

stakeholders.name: Nigeria Gemstone Miners Cooperative Union
stakeholders.description: Organise gemstone miners into cooperatives and facilitate market access and improved practices.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Cooperative organisation, marketing and basic value addition for gemstones.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Supports registration of gemstone cooperatives; negotiates better prices; promotes safer mining and basic processing; links miners to buyers in local and export markets.

stakeholders.name: Association of Small-Scale Quarry Operators of Nigeria
stakeholders.description: Represent small-scale quarry operators and ensure fair regulation and sustainable operations.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Representation of small-scale quarrying within the broader ASM and construction value chain.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Engages with regulators on licensing and compliance; supports members on environmental and safety issues; advocates for infrastructure and fair levies for small quarries.
stakeholders.mineralFocus: Quarry products â€“ granite, laterite, sand etc.

stakeholders.name: PAGMI Gold Cooperatives Network
stakeholders.description: Formalise artisanal gold miners into cooperatives under the Presidential Artisanal Gold Mining Development Initiative (PAGMI).
stakeholders.valueChainRole: ASM formalisation, responsible gold production and integration into formal value chains.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Organises gold miners into registered cooperatives; provides access to legal markets and official offtakers; promotes safer practices and better community and environmental outcomes.

stakeholders.name: Bauchi Mining Synergy and Exploration Limited (BAMSEL)
stakeholders.description: Develop mineral resources on behalf of Bauchi State, including through partnerships with ASM cooperatives.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Project development, investment partnership and support for ASM-linked projects.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Carries out exploration and early-stage development; partners with cooperatives and private investors; helps integrate ASM areas into more structured projects.

stakeholders.name: Ijero-Ekiti Gemstone Miners Cooperative
stakeholders.description: Organise gemstone miners in the Ijero-Ekiti area into a cooperative for better regulation and market access.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Local cooperative organisation, marketing and engagement with government.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Helps members obtain formal titles and permits; negotiates prices; supports safer and more coordinated mining and community relations.

stakeholders.name: Aramoko Small-Scale Miners Group
stakeholders.description: Provide a basic platform for small-scale miners around Aramoko to coordinate operations and negotiate with buyers.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Informal coordination of ASM, basic market and logistics support.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Shares information on buyers and prices; organises informal rules for pit access and dispute resolution; serves as a contact point for government outreach.

stakeholders.name: Karu Gemstone ASM Association
stakeholders.description: Represent artisanal gemstone miners operating around Karu and neighbouring areas of Nasarawa State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Representation, advocacy and basic self-regulation of gemstone ASM.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Engages with state and federal regulators; supports cooperative registration; promotes better environmental and safety practices among members.

stakeholders.name: Jos Tin & Columbite Small-Scale Miners Cooperative
stakeholders.description: Organise small-scale tin and columbite miners around Jos into a cooperative framework.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Coordinated production, marketing and compliance support for small-scale tin mining.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Registers members; coordinates sales and pricing; engages on tailings management and safety; provides a collective voice in policy dialogues.

stakeholders.name: Barkin Ladi Gemstone Miners Association
stakeholders.description: Represent artisanal gemstone miners in Barkin Ladi LGA of Plateau State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Representation and coordination of gemstone ASM at local level.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Links miners with buyers; supports conflict resolution; engages with local authorities on environmental and security issues.

stakeholders.name: Bagega Gold Miners Association
stakeholders.description: Organise gold miners in Bagega area for improved safety, health and formalisation.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Cluster-level self-organisation and engagement with public health and regulatory programmes.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Acts as a focal point for health interventions and safer mining campaigns; helps move miners into cooperatives under government programmes.

stakeholders.name: Anka Small-Scale Miners Cooperative
stakeholders.description: Provide a formal structure for small-scale gold miners in and around Anka, Zamfara State.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Formal ASM cooperative structure for licensing, training and marketing.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Helps members obtain licences; coordinates sales to formal buyers; participates in government-supported programmes on safer mining and mercury reduction.

stakeholders.name: Mambilla Plateau Gemstone Miners Cooperative
stakeholders.description: Organise artisanal gemstone miners on the Mambilla Plateau.
stakeholders.valueChainRole: Cooperative organisation and marketing for gemstone ASM.
stakeholders.summaryFunctions: Coordinates mining activities; organises collective selling; supports community negotiations and basic environmental stewardship.
